children: Consumer credit platform novio, operated by Credilio Financial Technologies, has partnered with Indian Overseas Bank to launch a co-branded RuPay credit card, targeting UPI-active customers and first-time credit users.
The partnership combines IOB’s banking infrastructure and nation-wide reach with novio’s digital onboarding, UPI-focused customer experience and rewards platform.

The card will offer instant digital onboarding and an FD-backed credit facility, allowing customers with limited or no formal credit history to access a credit card while building their credit bureau profile through responsible usage.
The offering will be available in two variants — RuPay Select and RuPay Platinum.
The partnership comes as fintech and banking players increasingly seek to use UPI-linked customer engagement to expand formal credit access beyond conventional card users.
Joydeep Dutta Roy, Executive Director, IOB, and Aditya Gupta, Founder & CEO, novio, unveiled the card at the Global Fintech Fest at the NPCI Pavillion.
Aditya Gupta, Founder and CEO, novio said access to credit should be simpler, more inclusive and designed around the needs of today’s customers.
The partnership, he said, would combine novio’s technology, distribution reach and rewards ecosystem with IOB’s banking capabilities to make credit accessible to more consumers, he said.

For novio, the IOB partnership is part of a broader expansion strategy following its recent ₹100-crore Series A funding round led by Cornerstone Ventures, with participation from Shepherd’s Hill Private Equity, ESV-Arthya AIF and Roots Ventures. The company also raised venture debt from Innoven Capital and Alteria Capital.
The fresh capital is expected to support novio’s plan to issue 50 lakh credit cards over the next three years and expand formal credit access to customers in tier-V cities.

Founded by Aditya Gupta, along with Sandeep Ghule, Anand Kapadia and Manish Sinha, novio is building technology-led credit solutions that leverage digital payments and innovative lending models to enable greater financial inclusion.
The company said the expansion will focus on using digital distribution and technology to make credit products more accessible to customers outside India’s major urban centres.

title: novio, IOB launch co-branded RuPay credit card to widen access to formal credit
